body:
Founder real-time direction, clarified through a few rounds of back-and-forth ("all items besides
Blink Dagger and Donkey" -> "about triple, and some more" -> AskUserQuestion offered WEIRD-tier/
page-4/all-31 scopes -> founder's own typed follow-up settled it: "not all items the page 4 items
need tripple costs" -- "some of the other need adjustment too but will be handled in further
iterations"). Scope: exactly the 6 page-4 items, exactly 3x, nothing else touched this pass.

Gae Bolg 1000->3000, Masamune 1100->3300, Muramasa 1150->3450, Balance Ring 900->2700,
Empress Hairpin 450->1350, Ninja Tekko 500->1500.

Verified: bash scripts/test_arena.sh all green, bash scripts/build.sh clean (pre-existing
missing-field-initializer warnings only, not introduced by this change). README item table +
mechanics section updated to match. Commit <pending, see git log>.
title: Tripled Flow cost of the 6 page-4 items
